name: ligphidonk/academic-figure-generator
description: A collection of skills for generating academic figures, with prompt-based figure styles (including a pastel variant) that turn research content into publication-ready graphics.
install: npx skills add LigphiDonk/academic-figure-generator, or git clone and cp -r academic-figure-generator/academic-figure-prompt .claude/skills/ (and .gemini/skills/)
